source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The updater calls this.onUpdate(notificationJson) without await. The controller callback calls async updateNotifications without returning its promise. The test stubs a synchronous throw and verifies _fetch reports failure. That catch does not establish handling for a promise that rejects later. This is a narrow static async-contract and test-coverage concern, not a reproduced failure or a claim that every fetch failure is mishandled.
title: Distinguish a synchronous callback error from a rejected promise
